verdict.rationale: Baseten has a dedicated Model APIs pricing-and-limits page. It documents that request and token rate limits are enforced, exposes x-ratelimit-remaining-requests headers so developers can track headroom, and describes Basic, Pro and Enterprise tiers, with Basic limits raised through email verification. The core story is covered, but the evidence never shows actual numeric limits per tier, so how limits scale is only implied. missing for 10: concrete per-tier rate-limit values showing how limits scale, rate-limit documentation for dedicated deployments beyond Model APIs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
